D.t: Mark DeSaulnier leads by 62.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 165,565 votes; a one point swing is about 1,321 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +56.1 and D +68.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
